default.shell: /usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e 'var s = $.NSUserDefaults.alloc.initWithSuiteName("com.apple.alr"); var list = ObjC.unwrap(s.objectForKey("DenyList")) || []; (list.some(function(item) { return ObjC.unwrap(item.objectForKey("SigningID")) == "com.apple.FaceTime"; }) && s.objectIsForcedForKey("DenyList")) ? "PASS" : "FAIL"'

discussion:
The macOS built-in FaceTime.app _MUST_ be disabled, unless FaceTime is an approved collaboration tool.

The FaceTime.app establishes a connection to Apple's iCloud service, even when security controls have been put in place to disable iCloud access.

[IMPORTANT]
====
Preventing the launch of any application using the DeniedBinaries key will also prevent the launching of ad-hoc signed binaries and unsigned binaries.
====

[NOTE]
=====
Apple officially supports installation through DDM of this configuration, however installation using a mobileconfig profile with the domain of com.apple.alr will also block the launching of binaries.
=====
